Touya: "...Agarthia...?
What's that?"
Forzen: "It's the name of the world where I was born and raised.
It's a different world from the one we're in now.
To be precise, it's another world that branched off
from the world you lived in.
It's said to have been created about 4,000 years ago,
but the details are rather hazy,
and no one knows for certain."
Touya: "Created...?"
Forzen: "According to the story I was taught, to defeat a mighty demon king,
three giant gods descended. During the battle,
they unleashed so much energy that it threatened
to destroy the world. To prevent its destruction,
they created a space that is said to have become
the foundation of Agarthia."
Touya: "Why would people live in a place like that?
Don't tell me they evolved at some ridiculous speed?"
Forzen: "No. We are the same
'human beings' as the people of this world."
Touya: "Huh?"
Forzen: "In other words, people from this world were transported to Agarthia
when it was created, and their descendants flourished there
right up to the present day."
Touya: "So that's why you called it 'another world'...
But what's someone from that world doing over here?"
Forzen: "Oh? Have you forgotten already?
I came to 'protect' people like you..."
Touya: "That's not what I... Hm? 'People like me'?
There are others?"
Forzen: "Yes. Six so far.
We still don't know why you have become beings
who aren't anchored to this world.
However, we believe it has something to do
with what happened three years ago."
Touya: "What happened three years ago?"
Forzen: "To be precise, 109 years ago,
researchers led by Bafred Debish
triggered a huge, mysterious explosion: the 'Terror of Ze=Ode'.
That was the beginning of it all."
Touya: "What's something that long ago got to do with this?"
Forzen: "The scale was different, but the reaction back then
was remarkably similar to the one three years ago."
Touya: "...And?"
Forzen: "I'm not sure what you mean by 'and'..."
Touya: "That's all you've got?"
Forzen: "That's all."
Touya: "So three years ago, there was an explosion like the one
109 years ago. And that's all it took for your world
to start taking action?"
Forzen: "Well, yes. But only a small minority have
taken serious action. It's a shame, when Ze=Ode's return
is all but certain."
Touya: "What's your proof?"
Forzen: "That's a trade secret."
Touya: "Y-you've got some nerve..."
Forzen: "Oh? You're willing to help us?
Then let's get right to... Ah, just a moment, please.
Now then... Your signature on this new contract..."
Touya: "Like hell I am. Damn, I can't let my guard down
around you for a second."
Forzen: "Well, at any rate, to stand against that Ze=Ode,
we keep working day and night.
As for you, if there's an 'effect',
there must be a 'cause'. Once we know what it is,
a solution should reveal itself."
Touya: "That's awfully vague..."
Forzen: "Much of reality lies buried in vague
phenomena, you know."
Touya: "I couldn't care less about your philosophy.
What I want to know is, what exactly IS this Ze=Ode?"
Forzen: "Hmm, shall I explain in detail?
It should only take about five hours."
Touya: "...Keep it brief, please."
Forzen: "Really? What a shame.
Well, to put it simply, Ze=Ode is
something like a demon. That is all."
Touya: "...No, uh, could you be a little more specific...?"
Forzen: "My, aren't you demanding...
Hmm... Well, there's very little data from that time, so
we don't know the details,
but the prevailing theory is that it's an ancient Armored Mech."
Touya: "An 'Armored Mech'?"
Forzen: "A robot. You have anime about those
in your world too, don't you?"
Touya: (Does he mean that robot I saw?)
Forzen: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "No... Anyway, you know a lot about our world."
Forzen: "Believe it or not, I'm quite the diligent student.
Anyway, an attempt to use that ancient Armored Mech's power
to 'purify humanity in Agarthia'
was behind the incident 109 years ago."
Touya: "Was that the work of this Debish guy you mentioned?"
Forzen: "Yes. But his collaborators,
Dr. Wenimas and Dr. Lenis, tried to stop him as
the machine was being activated. Then came the enormous explosion.
The damage was certainly immense, but Dr. Debish
never achieved his aim, and we were saved.
However, Ze=Ode had
vanished from the site without a trace.
Now that the data has been lost, this is about all
we know."
Touya: "So the incident 109 years ago
was a plot by this Debish guy,
and two doctors who were working with him stopped him.
That caused a huge explosion, and the same kind of
reaction was detected three years ago.
And now, to face Ze=Ode, which may have returned,
you're getting everything ready. Is that it?"
Forzen: "Excellent. You catch on quickly;
that makes my job easier. ...Now then, we should be
arriving any moment now."
??: "You're late! Do you have any idea what time it is?!"
Forzen: "Ah, I'm terribly sorry."
??: "Fine, whatever. ...So, is this the one?"
Forzen: "Yes. Oh, I haven't introduced you.
This is Ai Tennoji.
Like you, she's someone I took into protective custody."
Touya: "Don't you mean 'kidnapped'?"
Forzen: "You're giving people the wrong idea...
Could you at least say I 'duped' you?"
Ai: "Hmm..."
Touya: "Wh-what?"
Ai: "You're pretty cute."
Touya: "What's that supposed to... Oh."
Touya: "You... Haven't we met before?"
Ai: "Huh? No, this is the first time."
Touya: "You sure? Even your voice is the same..."
Ai: "Ohhh, I get it... No, no.
If you're going to hit on me, you'll need a better line.
You'll never make a proper ladies' man like that."
Touya: "I don't want to be one!"
Ai: "Oh, so you're the serious type?
Hmm, you've got quite a bit of pride."
Touya: "What are you talking about?"
Forzen: "Well, I still have a few things to attend to, so
I'll take my leave here.
Ai, I'll leave the rest to you."
Ai: "Okaaay!"
Ai: "Right, we'd better get going."
Yamato: "Meoow."
Ai: "...You're bringing that cat too?"
Touya: "She's my 'family'."
Ai: "Family... I see."
Touya: "...You're not going to laugh?"
Ai: "Why would I?"
Touya: "Well, when I say that, most people either laugh at me
like I'm an idiot, or look at me like I'm hopeless."
Touya: "You're the third person who's actually listened."
Ai: "...Hey. What's the kitty's name?"
Touya: "Yamato."
Ai: "I see. Yamato, do you want to come with us?"
Yamato: "Meow."
Ai: "Good kitty. We've got your consent too, so that's settled.
Well, then... Oh, right. Hold out your arm."
Touya: "Huh? Ah, h-hey..."
Touya: "Ow!"
Touya: "Wh-what the hell are you doing?! Was that... a shot?
!! Y-you didn't inject me with some weird drug, did you?!"
Ai: "Of course not! It's just a little charm.
Now, take my hand."
Touya: "I'll pass."
Ai: "Oh, stop being such a baby! Come on!
Here we go. Transport!"
Touya: "H-hey...!!"
Alforina: "...Are you sure this was the right decision?
For you, the crown prince of the Kingdom of Agarthia,
to go so far as to defy your own country's decision..."
Lodis: "It's been three years since Rayfon's death.
At last, we've made it this far.
I have no regrets whatsoever.
On the contrary, I'm grateful for the workings of fate,
which allowed me to meet someone as understanding as you,
Queen Alforina."
Alforina: "N-no... I, um,
if I could only help bring peace
to this world of Agarthia..."
Lodis: "Heh heh heh."
Alforina: "...O-oh, speaking of which, it must nearly be
time for the 'transport'."
Lodis: "Yes. Ymir should be there to meet them.
We can leave the explanation to her.
...Still, it pains me that we must rely on people from another world
rather than handle this ourselves."
Alforina: "...Yes. From their point of view,
we're simply using them.
But if we are to prevent that terror from happening again..."
Lodis: "Yes. That's why we've come this far.
We cannot afford to worry about appearances."
Alforina: "...It's a painful position to be in."
Lodis: "Yes. Oh, that reminds me. I have something
to give you today..."
Alforina: "Something to give me?"
Lodis: "Yes. I must leave here tomorrow,
and I didn't want to miss the chance to give it to you...
I hope you like it."
Alforina: "A pendant...?
Oh! You remembered?"
Lodis: "Of course.
It's a day early, but happy birthday."
Alforina: "I'm so happy... U-um, would you...
put it on for me?"
Lodis: "Gladly."
Alforina: "It's beautiful..."
Lodis: "It suits you very well."
Touya: "Ugh... Wh-what was that...?"
Ai: "Here we are."
Touya: "Wh-where are we...?"
Ai: "York's summoning facility, in the world of Agarthia.
...By the way... How long are you going to hold my hand?"
Touya: "O-oh, right..."
????: "Welcome to Agarthia,
Mr. Touya Kazami."
Touya: "..."
????: "...Is the 'Adjuster' not working?
Ai, did you administer it properly?"
Ai: "I took care of it before we came here."
????: "Um... Can you understand what I'm saying?"
Touya: "...Was that treatment the shot she just gave me?"
????: "Y-yes. It's called an 'Adjuster'.
It transmits translated concepts at the language level
through the nerves in the cerebral cortex's language area.
It's doing so right now, in fact.
You should be able to understand me clearly..."
Touya: "Come to think of it, your lips and your words
are weirdly out of sync..."
????: "I think you'll get used to it soon."
Touya: "..."
????: "Oh, the 'Adjuster' isn't dangerous
at all. In fact, everyone in Agarthia uses one,
without exception. Myself included, of course."
Touya: "...So that's why you can understand me too."
????: "Yes. Your lip movements are slightly
out of sync too, Mr. Kazami."
Touya: "...You seem to know my name, but..."
????: "Oh, I'm sorry.
My name is Ymir Eal Clasio."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "? Um... Is there something on my face?"
Touya: "..."
Touya: (This feeling...)
Touya: (...She doesn't look the same, but...
something about her feels the same...)
Ymir: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "N-no. I just feel like we've met somewhere before..."
Ymir: "???"
Ai: "Hmmm... Is that
your standard routine or something?"
Touya: "Huh? It's nothing like that."
Ai: "Sure, sure. You'd better watch out too, Ymir.
'Haven't we met somewhere before?'
'You look like someone I used to love.'
They're classic pickup lines."
Ymir: "...Pickup lines?"
Ai: "Things a guy says to hit on a girl."
Ai: "You don't have a boyfriend, right, Ymir?
Then it's perfect. Why don't you go out with him?
He's pretty good-looking when he keeps his mouth shut."
Touya: "Wha--?!"
Ymir: "What? I-I couldn't..."
Ai: "Ooh, ooh! You might make a pretty good couple."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Hey! You're making her uncomfortable!
I really did feel like we'd met somewhere before..."
Ai: "Obviously, I'm joking!
Though Ymir doesn't seem entirely against the idea."
Ymir: "Oh, stop teasing me! ...Ahem.
Um, I know this must all be very sudden and confusing,
but I promise we'll find a way to get you home, so
please give us just a little more time."
Touya: "...Well, it's not your fault.
I'll be patient."
Ai: "...You're treating her pretty differently from me, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm just responding in kind."
Ai: "What's THAT supposed to mean?! You're so annoying!"
Ymir: "That's enough from you too, Ai.
She doesn't mean any harm.
Please forgive her, Mr. Kazami."
Touya: "Right... Miss Clasio, was it?"
Ymir: "Yes. Just Ymir is fine.
That's easier, isn't it?"
Touya: "Yeah. I'll do that.
Then you can just call me Touya too."
Ymir: "Oh? No, I..."
Ai: "Forget it. Ymir gets oddly hung up on
formality. Especially with men she's just met.
If you want her to use just your name, you have to be her boyfriend,
or know her long enough for her to get used to you."
Ymir: "H-her boyfriend...?"
Ai: "My, you're surprisingly innocent!"
Ymir: "O-oh, really! Ai!"
Touya: "W-well, if that's how it is, I won't force you,
but I'll just call you Ymir."
Ymir: "Oh? Ah, y-yes."
Ai: "Hey, there's no point hanging around down here.
Shall we go upstairs?"
Ymir: "Y-yes. I need to introduce you to everyone too.
This way, please."
??????: "Ah, our guest has arrived, I see."
Ymir: "Ah, y-yes.
This is Mr. Touya Kazami."
??????: "A pleasure to meet you.
I am Oswald Reio Exogilm.
I have the honor of serving as York's chancellor.
I look forward to making your acquaintance."
Touya: "I'm Touya Kazami. Nice to meet you too.
So, what's going to happen to me now?"
Oswald: "You are aware that this world is currently
facing a crisis, yes?
Here in York, we are currently building Spirit Mechs
to serve as our trump card against Ze=Ode.
The other nations underestimate Ze=Ode's power,
and frankly, the project is facing considerable difficulties."
Touya: "So you don't have many people helping out."
Oswald: "Indeed. York is a technologically advanced nation,
but unfortunately, we can hardly be said
to be a powerful country.
Fortunately, thanks to the efforts of His Highness Crown Prince Lodis
of the Kingdom of Agarthia, we've made it this far, but establishing
a formal unit will still take some time.
And the particularly serious issue is the shortage
of Spirit Mech pilots."
Touya: "...So you want me to get in one of these Spirit Mechs
and help you wage war?"
Ai: "Hey!"
Ymir: "I understand why you would think that.
But please understand this much:
our purpose is to protect the world from Ze=Ode.
We did not build the Spirit Mechs for war
or slaughter."
Oswald: "Of course, we will not force you.
But unlike Armored Mechs, Spirit Mechs
are not machines just anyone can pilot.
People like you and Ai, who have come
to Agarthia, have demonstrated a high degree
of synchronization with Spirit Mechs.
And all six of those people have, out of goodwill,
agreed to help us."
Touya: "And that means I have to help you too?
That's pretty self-serving logic."
Ymir: "That's not what we mean.
If you don't want to, we won't force you.
Our original purpose is to 'protect' you."
???: "Oh my, what's gotten into everyone?
Why the long faces?"
Ai: "Oh, Celica. Ah, you're still dressed like that.
Aren't you going home with Lodis and the others?"
Celica: "It's fine, it's fine. Anyway, the adjustments to Vishal
are finished."
Ai: "What?! Seriously?"
Celica: "If I say it's finished, you know it's perfect."
Ai: "Yes! Then I'm off to check it out.
Ymir, I'll leave the rest to you!"
Ymir: "W-wait, Ai! Not yet!"
Ai: "Aww..."
Touya: "...What's Vishal?"
Celica: "It's the name of a Spirit Mech. Its pilot is her,
Ai Tennoji. And the one who designed it was yours truly.
Nice to meet you, Touya."
Touya: "You designed it? Really?"
????: "How insolent! Do you know whom you are addressing?!
You stand before the first princess of the Kingdom of Agarthia,
Her Highness Celica Laniard Mestina!"
Celica: "Hey, Fain! ...Sorry about that."
Touya: "...Nah, I don't really mind...
But you're a princess?"
Celica: "Heh heh, I don't look like one, do I?
Well, I don't really feel like one either.
Oh, right. I should introduce him too.
He came along as my bodyguard, technically..."
Fain: "I am Fain Jin Barion!
I'll cut down anyone who insults the princess, without mercy!"
Touya: "Uh... I'll be careful."
Fain: "..."
Touya: "Wh-what? Stop staring at me."
Fain: "So you're Touya... You've got honest eyes.
You don't seem like a bad fellow."
Touya: "W-well, thanks.
I'm starting to feel like a celebrity."
Celica: "I'm sure you've heard already, but we have the machines
and no one to pilot them.
So when someone new comes over here, everyone talks about them,
whether they like it or not. Just accept it as your fate."
Oswald: "Unfortunately, he appears to have no intention
of piloting a Spirit Mech."
Celica: "Hmm. Well, want to take a look at one anyway?
They're pretty cool. I think you'll like them."
Ai: "Good idea! Come on, let's go!"
Touya: "Nah, I'll pass."
Celica: "Oh, don't be like that!
Come on, just a quick look. This way!"
Ymir: "Wait, Celica. We need to properly inform Queen Alforina
that Mr. Kazami has arrived."
Celica: "What? That can wait till later.
Alforina won't mind a little thing like that."
Ymir: "But we should handle this properly..."
Oswald: "Then I shall inform Her Majesty.
It would hardly be a poor choice to see the Spirit Mechs
that Princess Celica is so proud of."
Celica: "Right. I'll leave that to you, then."
Oswald: "As you wish, Princess."
Fain: "That man... Could he have feelings for the princess after all...?"
Celica: "Hm? Oh, don't worry about that.
He's only got eyes for Queen Alforina.
Besides, apparently I don't meet his age requirements."
Touya: "Age requirements?"
Celica: "He's not interested in anyone 16 or older."
Touya: "S-sixteen...?"
Celica: "Well, that's why I'm safe. Got it?"
Touya: "Uh..."
Ai: "Oh, I'm 15. I'd better watch out..."
Fain: "You're quite safe."
Ai: "Hey, what's that supposed to mean?"
Fain: "You lack 'grace'."
Ai: "Guh... Y-you know how to hit a sore spot..."
Fain: "...Hm? Wait a moment..."
Ai: "Wh-what? Stop staring at me."
Fain: "Hmm... On second thought, you may qualify after all."
Ai: "What?! Y-you think so? I knew it!"
Fain: "Yes. You've got a little kid's build for your age,
so you're probably within his acceptable range."
Ai: "Gah!"
Touya: "Ha ha ha!"
Ai: "Hey!
What are YOU laughing at?!"
Fain: "Yes. Quite an accurate assessment, if I do say so myself."
Touya: "Yeah."
Ai: "Y-you two...!"
Celica: "...Whatever. You do realize you've changed the subject,
you two?"
Oswald: "Your Majesty, the new pilot candidate,
Touya Kazami, has arrived."
Alforina: "Thank you. But whether he pilots a Spirit Mech
is not for us to decide.
Our primary purpose is to 'protect' people like him."
Oswald: "Yes, Your Majesty."
Alforina: "..."
Oswald: "..."
Alforina: "Y-you may leave now."
Oswald: "......"
Alforina: "Lord Exogilm?"
Oswald: "Your Majesty... You are as beautiful as ever...
You are so lovely."
Alforina: "Ah, thank you..."
Oswald: "That long, beautiful hair, that pale, translucent
skin, those eyes one could lose oneself in, like a starry sky...
And it's not merely your looks... You have such kindness and grace as well."
Alforina: "Heh heh... As flattering as ever."
Oswald: "Ah, what a charming voice..."
Alforina: "U-um..."
Oswald: "The line of your cheeks, still so childlike...
Those innocent eyes... Heh heh heh heh..."
Alforina: "W-wait... Lord Exogilm?"
Oswald: "If only...
If only time could stand still for you just as you are..."
Alforina: "Oh! Th-that's right!
I-I promised to choose a dress
for my birthday party!
...Please excuse me, Lord Exogilm."
Oswald: "...Alforina... Heh heh heh heh..."
